accept_criteria: Every topic has grounded segment_ids from manifest
topic_relationships present and reference valid topic names
Thesis and topic summaries preserved or improved from pass-1 brief without contradiction
Hypotheses from content_context confirmed, revised, or rejected with evidence
reject_patterns: Topics missing segment_ids or referencing unknown segment_ids
topic_relationships empty when multiple topics exist
Unmapped topic segment_ids (theme_unmapped) across a material portion of manifest
Partial reanchor after truncation without decompose plan
